name: mac-shell-mcp
description: MCP server for macOS shell access, confined to configured roots with no shell interpretation
author: Rob Sherman

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Run a permitted command confined to the configured roots

tools.name: execute_external_command
tools.description: Run a permitted command outside the roots; requires an interactive client

tools.name: execute_pipeline
tools.description: Compose read-only commands, wiring stdout to stdin in process

tools.name: suggest_policy_config
tools.description: Summarize recorded usage into configuration a human may apply

MAC_SHELL_MCP_CONFIG.description: Explicit path to a policy file. Takes precedence over the home config.

MAC_SHELL_ROOTS.description: Comma-separated directories the agent may work in.

security.notes: No shell is invoked. The child environment is constructed rather than inherited. No tool mutates policy at runtime. find, git, rm and interpreters are absent by default.
